title: Phuket and Krabi Escapes | Unveiling Coastal Magic of Thailand
highlights: Discover Phuket and Krabi, where pristine white-sand beaches, lively nightlife, and rich local culture come together for an unforgettable adventure.
Visit Chicken Island, featuring its iconic chicken-shaped rock, stunning turquoise waters, and excellent snorkeling spots.
Climb the steep staircase to Tiger Cave Temple in Krabi and marvel at the breathtaking panoramic views of the lush landscape.
Relax on Railay Beach and capture stunning photos with the backdrop of dramatic limestone karsts and crystal-clear waters.
Explore Phi Phi Island, famous for its stunning beaches and crystal-clear waters, perfect for snorkeling and diving adventures.
overview:
About the Tour:
From the crystal clear water, scenic beaches to enthralling adventures and more, Phuket is drawing couples to its shores for decades. Often referred to as the Pearl of the Andaman, it is the largest island in Thailand and arguably the most famous one as well. With an exceptional coastline featuring long stretches of white sandy beaches fringed with casuarinas and palms, Phuket is undoubtedly a must-visit destination to have a romantic getaway.
On the other hand, lies the stunning town of Krabi along the coast of Southern Thailand. A place boasts of emerald blue waters, gleaming white sands, limestone cliffs and dense green wildlife sanctuaries. It is a cherry on top for adventure junkies for Krabi offers some thrilling adventure sports like wakeboarding, windsurfing, kitesurfing and much more!

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Phuket | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Phuket! Upon arrival at Phuket Airport, you will be transferred to your hotel. Check in and spend your day at leisure. Today, you can explore the beauty of Phuket by strolling through Phuket's Old Town. Next, you can visit Wat Chalong, the island’s largest and most revered Buddhist temple, and then you can head to Promthep Cape for stunning sunset views. After a day of exploration, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Phi Phi Island
days.desc: In the morning, get transferred from the hotel to the Phuket Marina to board the speedboat for the Phi Phi Island Tour. Spend an adventurous time journeying through Koh Poda Island, to admire its turquoise waters and white sandy beaches. Also, explore the Ko Kai, or Chicken Island, known for its unique rock formations and Tup Island, famous for offering various water sports options and scenic views, among other famous spots. Later, you'll be transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Visit to Tiger Kingdom | Day at Leisure
days.desc: In the morning, board your transfer to Tiger Kingdom. Experience the thrill of interacting closely with tigers and learning about their conservation. Later, get driven back to your hotel. You can even spend the rest of the day exploring Phuket's attractions like Tha Rua Shrine and Phuket Aquarium, where you can see sharks, stingrays, vibrant coral reefs, and colorful fish as you walk through transparent tunnels. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Tiger Kingdom Phuket Tickets - Big Tiger Encounter with Private Transfers

days.title: Transfer to Krabi | Day at Leisure
days.desc: In the morning, check out from the hotel and get transferred to your hotel in Krabi. Upon arrival, check in and spend the day at your leisure. You can visit Wat Kaew Korawaram Temple, a wonderful Buddhist temple with an impressive entrance and Thai-style architecture. Additionally, you can take a boat ride to explore Khao Khanap Nam or enjoy a elephant ride at Krabi Elephant Sanctuary. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Krabi 4 Islands Tour
days.desc: Today, you will be transferred to Krabi Pier to board a speedboat for the Krabi Four Islands Tour. During this visit, explore Phranang Cave, known for its scenic caves and beaches. Also visit Chicken Island, named after a stone formation resembling a chicken's head. Marvel at the sandbar that links Tup Island and Poda Island during low tide, ideal for sunbathing and snorkelling. Afterwards, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Krabi Rainforest Discovery Tour
days.desc: In the morning, board your transfer to the Krabi rainforest. En route, soak in the scenic landscape of the Rainforest, which houses a variety of flora, fauna and waterbodies. Explore the beautiful Tiger Cave Temple to see the tiger paw prints and towering Buddha statues. You can also climb the 1,260 steps to the hilltop shrine and admire the panoramic views of the Andaman Sea. Then, take a refreshing dip in the crystal-clear waters of the Emerald Pool. Later, get driven back to the hotel.
